name: test-android-apps
description: Test Android apps with emulator workflows for reproduction, screenshots, UI inspection, log capture, and performance profiling.

shortDescription.en-US: Reproduce issues, inspect UI, and capture performance evidence from Android emulators
shortDescription.zh-CN: 在 Android 模拟器中复现问题、检查 UI 并采集性能证据

longDescription.en-US: Use Test Android Apps to build and install app variants, drive a booted Android emulator with adb input events, inspect UI trees, capture screenshots, collect logcat output, and gather Simpleperf, Perfetto, gfxinfo, or memory/leak evidence while reproducing issues.
longDescription.zh-CN: 使用 Test Android Apps 构建并安装应用变体，通过 adb 输入事件驱动已启动的 Android 模拟器，检查 UI 树，截取截图，收集 logcat 输出，并在复现问题时采集 Simpleperf、Perfetto、gfxinfo 或内存/泄漏证据。

defaultPrompt: Use Test Android Apps to reproduce an emulator issue, then capture screenshots, logs, UI state, and performance evidence.

skillPreviews.name: android-emulator-qa
skillPreviews.description: Use when validating Android feature flows in an emulator with adb-driven launch, input, UI-tree inspection, screenshots, and logcat capture.

skillPreviews.name: android-performance
skillPreviews.description: Gather and interpret Android performance evidence on an adb target using Simpleperf CPU profiles, Perfetto or Compose traces, gfxinfo frame data, dumpsys meminfo snapshots, Java heap dumps, and native allocation traces. Use when asked to profile an Android app flow, find CPU-heavy functions, diagnose jank, capture startup or frame timing evidence, compare before/after performance, explain what code is taking time, or gather memory/leak profiling artifacts.
